assumption_note_zh: 每条假设都标注状态与影响。unknown、blocked 与 not_run 都不是放行，而是必须在专业团队接手前显式关闭的缺口。
assumption_note_en: Every assumption carries a status and an impact. unknown, blocked and not_run are not clearances; they are gaps that must be closed explicitly before a professional team takes over.

assumptions.statement: No official overall boundary or key-area polygon has been released, so every geometry layer in this package is provisional.
assumptions.impact: All areas, shares, densities and intensity statements are comparison-only and must be recomputed in full when the official geometry arrives. The recalculation interface is declared in metrics.json.boundary_basis.

assumptions.statement: Regulatory FAR, building height, road redlines, ownership and municipal utility conditions were not obtainable from public sources.
assumptions.impact: The package issues no development-intensity or height conclusion; it expresses only public-interface, reversible-service and evidence relationships.

assumptions.statement: Parcel ownership, existing leases and operating rights along the belt are unknown.
assumptions.impact: Demolish-retain-renovate is expressed as a function list with a four-step procedure, never as a named parcel list.

assumptions.statement: No survey-grade topography, DEM, pipe network, outfall, soil or groundwater data is available.
assumptions.impact: Blue-green and drainage proposals stay at source-control and route-safety level; no capacity or engineering conclusion is issued.

assumptions.statement: Rail corridor clearances, crossing conditions and operating constraints are unknown.
assumptions.impact: Every crossing and parallel section is marked as requiring railway-authority review before further development.

assumptions.statement: Heritage extents and construction-control zones around the Jing-Zhang relics are not published at usable precision.
assumptions.impact: Only reversible, demountable interventions are suggested inside the presumed heritage extent.

assumptions.statement: No resident, worker, commuter or visitor count is available for the belt at the required granularity.
assumptions.impact: Service-radius and 15-minute statements are expressed as design targets with a stated recalculation trigger, not as achieved coverage.

assumptions.statement: Continuous-accessibility breaks have not been field-surveyed.
assumptions.impact: The package claims no continuous accessibility; it defines the paired day-night walk test that would establish it.

assumptions.statement: No local PUE, green-power ratio, waste-heat network or compute-facility inventory exists for this belt.
assumptions.impact: Compute-energy coupling is a conceptual interface only; no local facility is claimed to exist or to comply.

assumptions.statement: No calibrated local wind, heat, air-stagnation or health-linkage measurement is available.
assumptions.impact: Comfort and air-quality statements remain design targets bound to a field protocol; no performance is claimed.

assumptions.statement: No embodied-AI test has been authorised or run on any public route in the belt.
assumptions.impact: Scenario S02 and its siblings stay at not_run with null performance results; the tabletop record is synthetic and labelled as such.

assumptions.statement: The twelve scenario cards, eight personas and all task records are synthetic composites authored for this submission.
assumptions.impact: They demonstrate governance structure and auditability, not observed behaviour; no card may be read as user research.

assumptions.statement: The agent-operation aggregates are recomputed from simulation.json task records generated inside this package.
assumptions.impact: They evidence internal reproducibility of the stated numbers only; they are not a benchmark result, a model evaluation or a field outcome.

assumptions.statement: The eight comparative districts are cited by name, operator and public URL without reproducing their content.
assumptions.impact: Each case carries an explicit applicability limit; no outcome from a cited district is projected onto this belt.

assumptions.statement: The acceleration area is named 众智园 exactly as written in the official announcement.
assumptions.impact: Any earlier working name is treated as an error and has been removed from the whole package.

assumptions.statement: Rights for fonts, code, figures, geometry and evidence files are declared asset by asset in report/copyright_statement.md and visual/assets/copyright-ledger.json.
assumptions.impact: The ledger is a self-declaration for auditability; it is not a legal clearance opinion.

assumptions.statement: The Chinese and English proposals are rendered from one paired data source, so section, block, table-row and heading counts are identical by construction.
assumptions.impact: Equivalence is structural and machine-checked; a human linguistic review is still recorded as an open next step in report/narrative.md.

assumptions.statement: The deterministic validator was run locally against this package before submission.
assumptions.impact: A local PASS evidences schema conformance only; it is not an official boundary, a professional seal, a government review or a competition score.

assumptions.statement: Removal reserves, spare-part stocks and retirement records are designed into the phasing but have no confirmed budget owner.
assumptions.impact: Any component without an accountable owner and a safe passive fallback must be frozen rather than scaled.

assumptions.statement: No authorised public participation, consultation or resident listening round has taken place.
assumptions.impact: Participation mechanisms are specified with authority, compensation and opt-out requirements, and are marked as not yet executed.
